post.description:
Exchange a valid bearer for a fresh token with the same claims.

The bearer in ``Authorization:`` is verified end-to-end (signature,
exp, revocation, audience) and then re-minted via
:func:`soma.auth.refresh_token`. The new token carries the same
``sub`` / ``bundles`` / ``aud`` as the original but a fresh ``jti``
and a fresh ``exp``.

Failure modes all return 401 (the bearer is itself the credential,
and revoking a token is the only way to block refresh loops):

- no/mismatched ``Authorization`` header
- expired, revoked, or malformed token
- server misconfigured (no signing key available)

The old token is NOT auto-revoked. Operators wanting rotation call
``POST /auth/revoke`` (or ``soma auth revoke``) explicitly before
or after refresh — intentional: revocation is orthogonal policy.

post.summary: Revoke a JWT (add its jti to the blocklist)
post.description:
Revoke a token. Either pass the full ``token`` to revoke it by
content, or pass ``jti``+``exp`` to revoke by identifier.

The blocklist entry's TTL is set to the token's ``exp`` so expired
entries self-evict — no manual GC required for the common case.
Same primitive as ``soma auth revoke`` (the CLI flow) — the two
surfaces write identical ``RevocationRecord``s into
``SOMA_JWT_BLOCKLIST_PATH`` (or Redis).

Requires ``admin`` scope on any bundle in the caller's claim; 401
without a valid bearer, 403 with a valid non-admin bearer, 400
when neither ``token`` nor ``jti``+``exp`` is supplied.

Delete memory entries.

Two dispatch branches:

1. **Legacy node_id**: ``{"node_id": "<id>"}`` removes exactly one
   entry via :meth:`MemoryLayer.forget`. Returns ``{"removed":
   true}`` on success, 404 otherwise. Pre-Phase-37 contract.
2. **Conversational criteria**: any of ``text_matches`` / ``subject``
   / ``user_id`` routes through the Conversational cascade
   (turns + derived facts + summary regenerate-or-drop) and
   returns the :class:`ForgetResult` / :class:`ForgetPreview`
   shape. Requires a ConversationalMemory to be wired through
   :func:`_get_conversational_memory`; returns 501 otherwise.

Every invocation (both branches) emits one audit record when
``SOMA_FORGET_AUDIT_PATH`` is set. The caller's ``principal.sub``
is stamped on the record; when the request body's ``user_id``
differs, the audit line carries both.

Write a one-shot MemoryLayer bundle to the client-supplied path.

Use case: an ephemeral session that wants to persist at shutdown
without reconfiguring the server-default ``SOMA_BUNDLE_PATH``. The
target path is validated to stay under the server's cwd (see
:func:`_resolve_snapshot_path`).

Per-tenant variant of :func:`snapshot` — saves the named bundle
to the caller-supplied path (same cwd-containment check).

jti.title: Jti
jti.description: Token id (if revoking without the token)

exp.title: Exp
exp.description: Token expiry unix timestamp — required with jti

AuthRevokeRequest.title: AuthRevokeRequest
AuthRevokeRequest.description:
Body for ``POST /auth/revoke``. Supply exactly one of ``token``
or ``jti``+``exp``.

- ``token``: revoke by presenting the full JWT. Server decodes and
  pulls ``jti``/``exp``. Callers don't need to parse.
- ``jti``+``exp``: revoke by identifier. Useful when the original
  token has already been rotated out of the caller's possession
  (e.g., the jti was lifted from an access log).

revoked.title: Revoked
revoked.description: The jti that was added to the blocklist

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Echoed reason or a generated default

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description: Uniform error body; mirrors FastAPI's HTTPException shape.

node_id.title: Node Id
node_id.description: Legacy: id of a single memory entry to remove. Mutually exclusive with the criteria fields below.

text_matches.title: Text Matches
text_matches.description: Substring to match against raw turn text. Case-insensitive by default; pass ``case_sensitive=true`` for an exact match.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: Equality match on each fact's ``metadata.subject``. Only hits hand-stamped facts until a future extractor phase populates it.

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: Equality match on each entry's ``metadata.user_id`` (Phase 12 multi-user scope). When the caller's JWT sub differs, the audit record carries both.

dry_run.title: Dry Run
dry_run.description: When True, return a ForgetPreview instead of deleting. Audit-logs either way.

summary_strategy.title: Summary Strategy
summary_strategy.description: ``'regen'`` (default) rewrites partially-covered summaries from surviving turns; ``'drop'`` deletes every matched summary without calling the LLM.

ForgetRequest.title: ForgetRequest
ForgetRequest.description:
Unified request body for ``POST /forget``.

Two shapes, dispatched at the handler:

- **Legacy** (Phase 4, unchanged): ``{"node_id": "<id>"}`` removes
  exactly that entry via :meth:`MemoryLayer.forget`.
- **Conversational** (Phase 37): any of ``text_matches``,
  ``subject``, or ``user_id`` routes through
  :meth:`ConversationalMemory.forget`, returning the richer
  :class:`ForgetResult` / :class:`ForgetPreview` shape. Mixing
  ``node_id`` with criteria is not supported — the handler picks
  the legacy branch when ``node_id`` is present.

``summary_strategy`` is the Phase 37 Task 3 opt-in: ``"drop"``
deletes every summary in the preview set even when survivors
exist (skipping the regeneration LLM call entirely).

removed.title: Removed
removed.description: True if the entry was deleted.

ok.title: Ok
ok.description: Liveness flag; always true when reachable.

loaded_bundles.title: Loaded Bundles
loaded_bundles.description: Count of bundles currently loaded into memory.

node_id.title: Node Id
node_id.description: Opaque id of the matched memory.

text.title: Text
text.description: Stored text of the matched memory.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Metadata attached when the entry was stored.

timestamp_step.title: Timestamp Step
timestamp_step.description: Monotonic step counter when stored (0 if unknown).

token.title: Token
token.description: Freshly-minted JWT with a new jti and exp.

exp.title: Exp
exp.description: Epoch-seconds expiry of the new token.

k.title: K
k.description: Max number of hits to return (top-k by score).

where.title: Where
where.description: Optional metadata filter; entries must match all keys.

hybrid_alpha.title: Hybrid Alpha
hybrid_alpha.description: 0..1 blend of dense vs sparse (BM25) score.

rerank_top_n.title: Rerank Top N
rerank_top_n.description: If set, cross-encoder rerank of this many candidates.

saved_to.title: Saved To
saved_to.description: Absolute bundle path written to disk.

path.title: Path
path.description: Filesystem path (relative to the server cwd, or absolute under cwd) where the bundle should be written. Paths that escape the server's cwd are rejected with a 400.

saved.title: Saved
saved.description: Always True when the HTTP status is 200.

path.title: Path
path.description: Absolute path the bundle was written to.

entries.title: Entries
entries.description: Number of memory entries in the saved bundle.

texts.title: Texts
texts.description: Batch of texts to embed in one call.

text.title: Text
text.description: Raw text to embed and store as one memory entry.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Arbitrary JSON tags for filtering at retrieval.

node_id.title: Node Id
node_id.description: Opaque id of the new memory entry.
